sql:
SELECT
  v.calendar_date AS date,
  v.label AS label,
  count(o.id) AS total_orders,
  round(sum(o.grand_total / COALESCE(er.rate, 1))) AS total_revenue_eur
FROM (VALUES
    (date '2025-11-21', 'Prior Friday'),
    (date '2025-11-28', 'Black Friday 2025'),
    (date '2025-12-05', 'Following Friday'),
    (date '2024-11-29', 'Black Friday 2024')
  ) AS v(calendar_date, label)
LEFT JOIN orders o
  ON date(o.placed_at) = v.calendar_date
LEFT JOIN exchange_rates er
  ON er.base_code = 'EUR'
  AND er.quote_code = o.currency_code
  AND er.as_of = v.calendar_date
  AND o.currency_code <> 'EUR'
GROUP BY v.calendar_date, v.label
ORDER BY v.calendar_date ASC

note: Revenue is sum of grand_total across all orders placed that UTC day, converted to EUR via exchange_rates (orders already in EUR use rate=1 since exchange_rates may not carry an EUR/EUR row). No order-status filter was applied since the request said "total orders/sales" without specifying a status; all orders placed that day are counted, including cancelled ones if any.
